sections.changelog:
1.59.1 - Rainbow 3D product hotfix

  • FIX: project 3D picker now inserts immediately after the project profile header instead of after the long article body.
  • UPGRADE: tower plates are clickable, demo mode includes an original clickable facade SVG, and real project images can use SVG unit polygons through the existing CMS contract.
  • BUYER JOURNEY: unit drawer now includes spec, drawing, advisor, purchase-check steps, non-binding legal copy, and a clearer purchase-check CTA.
  • DATA: project 3D leads now persist unit, floor, rooms, sqm, budget, timeline, advisor, reservation state, view bearing, and view altitude.
  • SEAM: when offers are enabled, purchase checks create a private non_binding_inquiry offer record with amount 0 for the future purchase screen.

1.59.0 - Rainbow 3D premium project picker

  • UPGRADE: project 3D module now renders a premium blueprint-style pseudo-3D tower picker with floor selection, unit selection, drag-to-rotate, view-from-unit mode, angle controls, orbit mode, and selected-unit fact panel.
  • Lead flow: callback and non-binding purchase-intent CTAs post to the existing /nadlan/v1/lead route with card_id, unit, floor, rooms, sqm, source=project_3d, and purchase_intent metadata.
  • Safety: demo units no longer publish fake prices. Illustrative mode labels itself clearly and renders prices as לפי פנייה until official owner/developer inventory is supplied.

1.58.1 - compound seed

  • NEW: idempotent Sde Dov compound seed. When the compound map flag is enabled, admin init ensures the sde-dov term exists and assigns the existing Rainbow project to it if found. No posts are created and no other terms are touched.

1.58.0 - compound 3D map

  • NEW: dark-launched Sde Dov-style compound fly-over map behind nadlan_feature_compound_map. Adds [nadlan_compound_map], Mapbox GL JS lazy loading, 3D building extrusion fallback, drone camera intro, project pins from nadlan_compound + lat/lng meta, and auto-embed on compound archives.
  • Safety: Mapbox token is stored only as an admin option, never in code. Missing token shows a friendly RTL notice instead of loading broken JavaScript. Healthcheck exposes compound_map enabled/token/pin status.

1.57.1 - compounds

  • NEW: nadlan_compound taxonomy (מתחמים) for grouping projects under a development compound (e.g., Sde Dov) with /compound/ archive, developer+contractor filter bar shortcode [nadlan_compound_filter], paid placement respected, healthcheck compounds block.

1.57.0 - interactive picker + offers + critical fix

  • CRITICAL FIX: three settings pages (NadLan AI, NadLan CTA, Preferred Partners) silently never saved because the submit button had no value attribute. Found by Cowork during activation; all three fixed and audited.
  • NEW (dark, nadlan_feature_project_3d): interactive apartment picker - clickable SVG units over the project render, RTL unit panel, lead CTA into the existing funnel, demo mode, admin metabox for render URL + units JSON.
  • NEW (dark, nadlan_feature_offers): non-binding price offers - per-card enable + minimum + transparency mode (sealed/leading), anti-sniping 24h window extension, phone dedupe, honeypot + 5/hour rate limit, owner notification. No success fee by design.
  • Concierge widget reframed: 'מענה מהיר' with honest human-review line (every conversation reviewed by a human rep).

1.56.1 - activation prep

  • NEW: Settings -> NadLan Features, master switchboard for all five dark features (the admin_control and help flags previously had no visible toggle when off).
  • Healthcheck now exposes a feature_flags block.
  • Marketing copy refresh on the homepage advertiser tile and the sponsored slot: benefit-led wording plus the free-for-limited-time listing promo.

1.56.0 - Chunk F contextual help framework

  • NEW: dark-launched in-app contextual help behind nadlan_feature_help, default off.
  • When enabled, Nadlan admin screens can use a single filterable help string store for accessible field tooltips, contextual Help tabs, WP pointer tours, and reusable empty states.
  • Safety: no frontend impact, scripts and styles lazy-load only on opted-in Nadlan admin screens, pointer dismissal uses a nonce and per-user dismissed_wp_pointers storage, and healthcheck exposes help loaded/string counts.

1.55.0 - Chunk E operator admin control

  • NEW: dark-launched operator admin control plane behind nadlan_feature_admin_control, default off.
  • When enabled, operators can validate and edit card city, lat/lng, reference links, and placement weight through a nonce/cap protected admin screen, meta box, and REST path.
  • Placement overrides are separate query-time signals: pinned, reserved slot, boost multiplier, and promo_until. They compose with paid placement and auction ordering and expire through cron.
  • Safety: every write is audited, the nadlan_operator role has nadlan_manage_clients but not manage_options, and view-as-advertiser sessions are time-boxed and read-only unless explicitly unlocked.

1.54.0 - Chunk D automated lead nurture

  • NEW: dark-launched email nurture flow behind nadlan_feature_lead_nurture, default off.
  • When enabled, Chunk B leads schedule score-aware follow-up touches through the existing lead delivery channel: day 1/3/7/14 for hot/warm leads, lighter cold cadence, then monthly win-back.
  • Safety: each touch has an atomic send guard, unsubscribe token, bounded non-PII audit log, and automatic stop on reply, contacted/won/lost status, AI handoff, or unsubscribe.
  • Healthcheck and Ops dashboard now expose lead_nurture scheduled, sent, active, stopped, and stopped-by-reason metrics.

1.53.0 - Chunk C AI lead qualification

  • NEW: dark-launched AI lead qualification behind nadlan_feature_lead_ai_qualify, default off.
  • When enabled with OpenAI, Chunk B leads are scored once, enriched with extracted budget/intent/timeline/location, routed as hot/warm/cold, and can receive a grounded email response through the existing lead delivery channel.
  • Safety: no OpenAI key or flag off means zero AI calls; per-lead token cap plus existing daily caps are checked before provider calls; low-confidence, off-topic, or human-request leads hand off without auto-reply.
  • Healthcheck and Ops dashboard now expose lead_ai qualified rate, average score, and hot/warm/cold counts.

1.52.0 - Chunk B lead end-to-end

  • NEW: dark-launched lead E2E flow behind nadlan_feature_lead_e2e, default off.
  • When enabled, card leads get idempotent capture, visitor acknowledgement, paid-owner routing, admin fallback, advertiser-center status workflow, bounded audit log, response-time metrics, and lead_e2e health/autopilot metrics.
  • OFF behavior remains the existing lead flow.

1.51.2 — AI loader order (Codex verification follow-up)

  • Load ai-provider before ai-features/ai-concierge so the OpenAI provider functions are canonical (removes any definition-precedence ambiguity Codex flagged). Runtime was already safe; this makes the architecture explicit.
  • /health version aligned to 1.51.2.

1.51.1 — consolidation fix (Codex-caught regressions)

  • FIX: AI concierge endpoint + settings now use the OpenAI adapter (nadlan_ai_chat) — the v1.51.0 merge had reverted it to the old Anthropic-only concierge. Grounding/sources-or-abstain/human-handoff restored.
  • FIX: Studio self-serve 'create listing → become advertiser' role assignment restored (lost in the v1.51.0 merge).
  • FIX: Ops dashboard lead-routing delivery trace restored alongside the autopilot metrics panel.
  • FIX: /health version string corrected from 1.50.0 to current.
  • SAFETY: role migration now explicitly skips administrators / super admins — owner account is never modified.

1.51.0 — consolidated foundation (9 tracks)

  • GAP 2 lead routing to paid owners (owner inbox + delivery log).
  • GAP 3 recurring billing via Morning IPN — sig adapter (X-Data-Signature hex/base64) + dunning d2/4/7/14 grace 27 + reconcile cron. Owner ops: set nadlan_gi_ipn_secret + Morning webhook.
  • GAP 4 AI provider switch — OpenAI default (gpt-4o-mini) + global+per-IP cost cap + sslverify pinned.
  • GAP 5 geo "near me" — bounding-box prefilter + LEAST(ACOS) guard + composes with paid placement + auction.
  • GAP 6 roles & capabilities — nadlan_advertiser / nadlan_buyer, owner-only listing edit via map_meta_cap.
  • GAP 7 placement auction — second-price GSP, ₪50 increment, scarcity-driven outbid.
  • AI-support hardening — RAG grounding, sources-or-abstain, human handoff via lead path, prompt-injection defense.
  • Business-metrics + autopilot — MRR/churn/NRR/MRR-at-risk/activation/deflection daily-cached.
  • Reliability + health — /wp-json/nadlan/v1/health, secret-scrubbing structured log, dependency probes.
  • Close-out — GDPR exporters/erasers, RealEstateListing JSON-LD, public-POST rate limit, security sweep clean.
  • 119 unit/integration assertions executed against this bundle; 2 real bugs caught and fixed pre-merge (Morning signature, geo×auction ORDER BY).

1.51.0 - seams + final hardening

  • NEW: final-hardening module with shared public POST rate limiting, privacy exporters/erasers for leads and AI logs, and future seams for closed leads, search execution, and schema extension.
  • Schema output now exposes card JSON-LD filters/actions before printing, including a RealEstateListing filter for theme extension.
  • AI settings no longer echo the stored Anthropic key, replacement keys save with autoload=false, and current Anthropic calls use sslverify=true through a centralized endpoint filter.

1.42.8 — paid placement boost

  • Revenue-critical fix: featured sorting on /professionals/ and /projects/ now orders paid_tier=premier first, then paid_tier=pro, then free cards. Manual menu_order remains the secondary tiebreaker inside each tier, followed by newest content.
  • Uses a scoped posts_clauses boost only for the featured sort so name/newest/unit sorts continue to behave as before.

1.42.7 — self-serve listing creation

  • NEW: any logged-in user can create a brand-new listing (property / project / professional) from /studio/ and edit it immediately. Closes the gap where only gov.il-imported cards could be claimed. POST /nadlan/v1/studio/create — owns the card (owner_user_id + claim_status=verified), starts as data_quality=stub (noindex until enriched), free tier, 10/user/day rate limit.
  • Studio picker page now leads with a 'create new listing' panel (type chooser + title), then lists the user's existing listings.

1.42.6 — block-theme footer on all plugin-rendered surfaces

  • Plugin-rendered archives (/professionals/, /projects/, /city/*/contractors/) and self-serve pages (/studio/, /advertiser-center/, /compare/, /referral-status/) were calling get_header()/get_footer() — which is a noop in block themes without a footer.php. Result: those pages had NO real footer, only the tiny .nadlan-nav-foot strip. Fixed by explicitly calling block_template_part('header'|'footer') in addition to get_header/get_footer. Now every plugin-rendered page shows the full premium footer.

1.42.5 — copywriting-skill audit + catalog image rotation

  • Em-dashes removed from public copy across directory/city-hubs/studio/featured-upsell/calculators/homepage modules (skill §2 ban).
  • Project catalog cards (/projects/) now rotate 5 real theme photos when no owner photo exists, instead of 2 dark concept SVGs that read as identical empty blocks across the grid.
  • Studio H1 colon instead of em-dash; placeholders cleaned.

1.42.4 — Codex PR #47 follow-up (proper H1 + honeypot + site-title fixes)

  • FIX #2 (proper): duplicate H1 on single CPT pages. 1.42.3 hid the theme's wp-block-post-title via CSS; 1.42.4 removes it from the DOM via a render_block filter scoped to nadlan_project/professional/property singles. The plugin's .nlpf-name is the single visible AND single semantic H1.
  • FIX #7 (proper): 'Written by / in' theme pattern on CPT singles. 1.42.3 hid post-author/date/terms blocks via CSS but the literal <p>Written by</p> / <p>in</p> paragraphs remained. 1.42.4 removes the post-author, post-author-name, post-author-biography, post-date, post-terms blocks AND the bare 'Written by' / 'in' paragraph blocks from the DOM via render_block.
  • FIX #5: .nlcard-hp / .nlrev-hp honeypot inputs used left:-9999px, giving desktop pages an 11,439px scrollWidth (visible horizontal scrollbar). Replaced with the accessible 1px clipped pattern — same screen-reader/sighted-user behavior, no page-extending geometry.
  • FIX #9: site-title <h1>נדלן חכם</h1> in the theme header created a second H1 on /projects/, /professionals/, /properties/ archives. Now visually hidden only on those three CPT archives via post-type-archive- body class scoping; every other page keeps its header H1.
  • Boundary preserved: no REST/business-logic changes; render_block filter is scoped to three CPTs and only touches presentational blocks. Disable via NADLAN_DISABLE_PREMIUM_UI.

1.42.3 - Post-QA polish (PR #45 findings)

  • FIX (Blocker): hero filter pills showed the raw SVG sprite id as text ('category-project', 'profession-developer', 'profession-contractor'). Now renders the SVG mark inside the pill via <use>.
  • FIX (Major): single project/professional/property pages had two H1s (theme's wp-block-post-title + plugin's .nlpf-name). Theme block-title is visually hidden via .visually-hidden equivalent; .nlpf-name remains the only visible H1.
  • FIX (Major): archive hero H1 was dark text on the dark blueprint backdrop — now light cream with a controlled text-shadow. Lead and crumbs follow the same contrast.
  • Polish: right-rail facet panel becomes a quiet premium card (white surface, hairline border, grouped sections) instead of plain default.
  • Polish: header submenu chevron .wp-block-navigation__submenu-icon gets a 24px tap-target box without changing the visible glyph.
  • Polish: generic theme post-meta ('Written by / in / date') hidden on single nadlan_project/professional/property profiles where it added noise.

1.42.2 - Original concept art (line-drawn architectural SVGs)

  • Replaces the stock-photo direction with original hand-authored SVG concept art: gold linework on deep blueprint teal — coastal skyline, abstract tower massing, floor-plan motif. No stock photos, no faces, no copied imagery.
  • Project cards now show a concept-art header (skyline / tower) when the listing has no owner photo. Owner-uploaded photos still win.
  • Single project profile hero (.nlpf-banner) uses the original skyline concept as backdrop instead of a flat gradient.
  • Directory hero gets a subtle (22% opacity) concept-skyline overlay.
  • Professional cards stay icon-only — never a stranger's face on a contractor card.
  • Ships assets/concept/ (5 SVGs from PR #43): skyline-telaviv-line, hero-coast-concept, project-concept, property-concept, blueprint-texture.

1.42.1 - Premium UI hotfix: single-profile headers

  • FIX: single professional/project profile avatar (.nlpf-av) showed the literal sprite id text (e.g. 'profession-developer') after 1.42.0 switched the icon map to SVG ids. Now renders the SVG profession mark via <use>, with the leftover text node zeroed.
  • Replaced remaining emoji in the .nlpf-* profile headers (shield, location pin, phone, units, status, developer) with inline SVG glyphs to match the premium catalog cards.

1.42.0 - Site-wide premium UI overlay

  • NEW inc/premium-ui.php injects a high-priority CSS layer + inline SVG sprite that lifts the catalog/profile/micro-UI from default WordPress directory to an editorial real-estate experience without rewriting directory.php or cards-render.php.
  • Killed emoji avatars on /projects/ and /professionals/ cards: profession/category marks are now SVG line marks (architect, lawyer, appraiser, contractor, developer, mortgage, inspector, broker, project, property), using Codex's premium asset pack from PR #39.
  • Replaced bright-pill category language and cyber palette with the ink/charcoal/champagne premium tokens; quieter borders, hairline-bottom category labels, calmer hover/focus, premier shows through layout not just a badge.
  • Sponsored slot (.nldc-sponsored-spot) rewritten from dashed placeholder to a premium ad-product card: champagne border, top gradient rule, centered SVG mark, refined CTA.
  • Profile-extras social chips (Facebook/Instagram/TikTok/YouTube/website) replaced their emojis with inline SVG glyphs and a calm ink color treatment.
  • Site-wide premium button grammar applied to .nlpf-call, .nlpf-quote, .nlcp-btn, .nlfab-btn, WooCommerce a.button/button.button, .wc-block-components-button, .wp-block-button__link, .wp-element-button: 48px minimum height, 12px radius, ink-gradient primary, gold-gradient alt, focus-visible outline.
  • Mobile (390px-first): article tables on /mortgage-*, /selling-*, /new-projects/*, /real-estate-lawyer/* convert to stacked label/value cards on small viewports; minimum 14px table text; hamburger and footer/nav/glossary links upgraded to 44px tap targets; floating CTA (.nlfab) re-anchored to the visual viewport with safe-area insets.
  • Boundary: no REST/business-logic changes; only directory.php meta tables (profession/category icons) and the new premium-ui.php module. Disable via define('NADLAN_DISABLE_PREMIUM_UI', true).

1.41.2 - Advertiser Center + paid-tier order bridge

  • NEW inc/advertiser-center.php adds /advertiser-center/ and /advertiser-dashboard/: logged-in advertisers see owned cards/projects/properties, completion score, views, inquiries, reviews, recent orders, Studio edit/upload links, and upgrade paths.
  • NEW inc/advertiser-orders.php preserves card_id through WooCommerce checkout and activates the existing paid_tier meta on woocommerce_payment_complete: 476->pro, 477->premier, 489->project premier, 490->property pro.
  • Paid card metadata is intentionally limited to campaign_end, paid_order_id, and paid_product_id; no parallel campaign_status is introduced.
  • Daily downgrade cron returns expired pro/premier one-time campaigns to free so a single payment cannot become permanent paid placement.
  • WooCommerce order-received and My Account now point paid products 476/477/489/490 to the Advertiser Center so advertisers know the next step immediately after checkout.
  • Research and reusable monetization standard captured in docs/2026-06-03-advertiser-monetization-research-and-center.md and skills/advertiser-monetization-system.md.

1.41.1 — CRITICAL FIX: /projects/ and /professionals/ were blank

  • Root cause: sponsored-spot.php (v1.40.0) used ob_start() on template_redirect and called nadlan_ss_card() — which itself used ob_start/ob_get_clean — from inside that output-buffer handler. PHP forbids nested output buffering in an ob handler → fatal → BLANK PAGE on every directory-rendered archive (both /professionals/ and /projects/) since v1.40.0. Rewrote sponsored-spot with ZERO output buffering: ob-free card builder + injection via a new nadlan_dir_cards_html filter (server) + safe rest_post_dispatch (AJAX). Both archives render again.

1.41.0 — Advertiser Studio (drag-drop upload + map picker + AI copy assist)

  • NEW /studio/ self-serve editor. Owner of a claimed nadlan_professional/project/property card can: drag-drop image upload, edit description with AI assist (5 modes via Claude Haiku), pick exact location on a Leaflet+OpenStreetMap map (zero-cost, no Google bill), add social links (FB/IG/TikTok/YT), embed YouTube/Vimeo video, edit type-specific fields. Six REST endpoints (auth: owner-only).
  • Public profile pages now render social pills + video embed (inc/profile-extras.php).
  • Studio auto-flips data_quality=enriched once a card has 80+ char description + 1+ photo (helps schema noindex guard).
  • User manual + design rationale in skills/user-manual-advertiser.md.

1.40.3 — kill sticky bar + exit-intent popup (owner request)

  • Removed the sticky bottom bar and the exit-intent modal entirely (mobile + desktop). They were too intrusive on mobile (mouseout fired on scroll, sticky bar jumped layout). Only the WhatsApp floating button + GA helper + /nadlan/v1/lead REST + Settings page remain in conversion-cta.php. To restore later: see git history of inc/conversion-cta.php at tag v1.40.2.

1.40.2 — HOMEPAGE 502 HOTFIX

  • Fixes the homepage 502 introduced by v1.40.0 social-proof block. The "recently claimed" + "popular this week" queries did meta_value_num sorts over 2,700-row postmeta with no index → PHP-FPM timeout → nginx 502 on the homepage only (admin + archives kept working). Hotfix: (a) 1h transient cache so it is one DB hit per hour from the second visitor, (b) cheap EXISTS probes that SKIP the heavy queries when no verified claims / no view counts exist (true today; turns on automatically when real data lands).

1.40.1 — owner-config REST + preferred-partners auto-route wiring

  • NEW inc/owner-config-rest.php exposes REST endpoints (auth: manage_options, app password OK) for owner config: GET/POST /nadlan/v1/owner/whatsapp and /nadlan/v1/owner/partners. Agents can now seed/update WhatsApp number + preferred partners without touching wp-admin.
  • FIX: closes the v1.40.0 gap — preferred-partners list is now ACTUALLY consulted when a lead lands. A save_post_nadlan_lead hook detects profession keywords in the goal/message, picks the best preferred partner by profession+city, and routes a partner-friendly email with the agreed commission %. Safety preserved: only people on the preferred list are ever emailed; the 2,700 imported contractors are never touched.

1.40.0 — overnight shark ship: 12 modules, money + moat

  • conversion-cta: sticky bottom bar + exit-intent modal + WhatsApp button + GA4 events (every page).
  • lead-inbox: unified admin dashboard for leads/referrals/reviews/claims/paid orders + daily digest email + admin notice badge.
  • preferred-partners: safe auto-routing — only approved partners get leads, never the 2,700 cold contractors.
  • featured-upsell: "your card is at position #X — upgrade for top-5" CTA on claimed-but-free profiles → direct cart links.
  • sponsored-spot: "your spot here" sponsored card injected into directory grid + AJAX load-more.
  • pricing-schema: Product + Offer JSON-LD on /join-pro/ for rich-result SERP.
  • claim-prompt: "this is my card?" CTA on every unclaimed profile → claim funnel → 30-day Pro trial.
  • ga4-events: dataLayer pushes for directory_card_click, profile_view, upgrade_click, quote_request, purchase (Woo).
  • sitemap-ping: pings Google/Bing on content changes (throttled). Pages indexed days faster.
  • social-proof: stats counters + "recently claimed" + "popular this week" social-proof block on homepage + view-counter.
  • term-faq-schema: FAQPage + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on glossary terms → rich-result expanders in Google.
  • og-image: dynamic SVG social-share preview for profiles/projects/terms (no external images needed).

1.39.0 — wire directory leads into the Lead Ledger (route to owner)

  • The "request a quote" button on a contractor profile now creates a TRACKED Lead Ledger referral routed to the owner (commission record + token + dashboard entry), instead of a plain email. Owner-chosen safe mode: notify_partner=false → no cold-emails to the 2,700 imported contractors, no premature customer follow-ups; the owner assigns/routes from the Lead Ledger when ready.

1.38.0 — remove "powered by WordPress" footer credit

  • Strips the WordPress theme-compat "נדלן חכם פועל על WordPress" credit paragraph that get_footer() printed on the plugin-rendered /professionals/ and /projects/ pages in a block theme. Targeted removal of only the wordpress.org credit link; nothing else touched.

1.37.0 — glossary archive title + premium project profile

  • Glossary archive now shows a clean Hebrew document title ("מילון מונחי נדל״ן…") instead of the default "ארכיון NadLan Glossary".
  • Single project pages get the premium colour profile header (banner, project-type pill, units/status/developer, gov source badge, "request info" lead CTA) — parity with professional profiles, which were bare before.

1.36.0 — FIX: projects directory was never live

  • v1.33.0 PR claimed to ship the premium projects directory but the code never landed on main; /projects/ has been falling through to the old paginated archive-grid this whole time. This release actually ships the premium projects directory: colour pills (תמ״א 38 / פינוי בינוי / בנייה חדשה / התחדשות), live AJAX filter+sort+search, load-more (NO pagination), 941 cards. archive-grid.php no longer grabs nadlan_project. v1.35.0 number was skipped (locked to Codex PR #17 which is closed).

1.34.0 — revenue rails + Lead Ledger + AI Concierge

  • Tier-upgrade CTA now opens the LIVE checkout (WooCommerce + Green Invoice/Morning) directly — Pro ₪349 + Premier ₪749, with FIRSTMONTHFREE coupon highlighted. No more "request a quote" stub.
  • NEW Lead Ledger (inc/lead-ledger.php): every referral creates a tracked nadlan_referral record with unique token, partner accepts terms via 1-click link (logged + IP-stamped = paper trail), CUSTOMER (not partner) confirms outcome at 14/30/60 days via tokenised /referral-status/ page, commission ledger logs owed vs paid, admin dashboard with KPIs. Solves the "deal closed and nobody paid me" problem with structural lock-in.
  • NEW AI Concierge (inc/ai-concierge.php): floating chat widget powered by Anthropic Claude API (haiku-4-5), RAG over our glossary + directory + pages, lead capture on intent, settings page for API key + usage/cost tracking. /nadlan/v1/concierge REST is the universal channel (WhatsApp/Telegram/external agents can hit it too).

1.33.0 — projects directory + REAL reviews engine (the moat)

  • /projects/ rebuilt as a premium directory mirroring /professionals/ (pink/purple/blue/green colour-coded project-type pills with icons + counts, sidebar facets, live AJAX filter/sort/search/load-more, 941 cards with city + units + יזם + status).
  • NEW reviews engine on nadlan_professional + nadlan_project: 5-star public reviews, moderation queue (CPT pending → publish), AggregateRating + Review schema.org JSON-LD (Google rich snippets in SERP = SEO juice), summary + recent reviews list + submission form auto-appended on every profile, admin email on every submission. Anti-spam: honeypot + 3/hour rate-limit + 30-day dup guard.
  • Reviews recompute the rating + reviews_count meta on every approval so the directory cards instantly show real ratings.

1.32.0 — premium professional profile pages

  • Single professional pages now open with a premium colour profile header (profession-coloured banner + avatar, trust badges incl. official רשם הקבלנים, rating area, call + "request a quote" lead CTA) above the existing details.
  • Added a "similar professionals" section (same profession/city) for discovery + internal linking.

1.31.0 — state-of-the-art professionals directory

  • /professionals/ rebuilt as a premium, colourful directory: gradient hero with search, colour-coded profession quick-pills with icons + live counts, sidebar facets (verified-only, top cities with counts), and premium colour-accented cards (avatar, profession pill, official רשם-הקבלנים trust badge, rating stars, location, CTA).
  • LIVE AJAX filtering & sorting (no page reload) via new /nadlan/v1/directory REST endpoint; "load more" pagination; active-filter chips; URL stays shareable.
  • City filter now partial-match (LIKE) so "תל אביב" finds "תל אביב יפו" — fixes the zero-results bug. Removed the duplicate facets form. Clean Hebrew page title (no more "Archive:").

1.30.0

  • CRITICAL FIX: directory archives (/professionals/, /projects/, /properties/) were showing only 5 of 2,702 records because the tier-priority sort forced an INNER JOIN on paid_tier meta, excluding every record without a tier set. Switched to a meta_query that returns ALL records and orders by date; tier priority will resume once we have tiered records. Also fixes city/profession filters that appeared broken (almost nothing left to filter).

1.29.0

  • Directory archive pages (/professionals/, /projects/, /properties/) now render real branded card grids instead of an empty theme page — fixes "empty archive" on every list link.
  • Homepage + footer "projects" link now points to /projects/ (the 941-project list) instead of the urban-renewal text page.
  • Cleaned whitespace padding in imported gov.il fields; ItemList schema on archives.

1.26.0

  • /catalog/ is now a directory hub: three premium category cards (registered professionals with live import count + pulse, urban-renewal projects, properties) each linking to its archive, with the featured-contractors showcase below. Replaces the empty property grid; if real properties exist they render between the hub and the showcase.

1.25.0

  • Homepage discoverability hero: 4 premium pillar cards on the front page linking to the actually-valuable destinations (professional directory with live count, glossary, urban-renewal, lawyer guide). Fixes the "no one knows where these pages are" gap.
  • Nav links added for /professionals/ and /glossary/; footer links for both as a fallback.
  • Featured professionals showcase: auto-injects a "מומחי נדל"ן רשומים" block at the top of /catalog/ showing 12 rotating real contractors from the gov.il import (was rendering empty after the demo properties were unpublished). Also exposes [nadlan_featured_pros count=N city=...].

1.24.0
